observed_q15_answer_before_safeguard: Students on academic warning are restricted from registering for more than five courses, and are not allowed to register for a new course unless recommended by the HoD and approved by Controller of Examinations.
issue: Second-warning and must/should scope was flattened in the model paraphrase.
remedy: Verbatim retrieved clauses for cited multipart rules containing different obligation levels; citations are revalidated.
final_q15_answer:
The policy states:

Registration of Students under Academic Warning

4.4 A student under academic warning or probation:
a) Must register for all such courses, in which the grade
was F, provided these courses are being offered.
b) Should register for all such courses, in which the grade
was D, D+ or C-, provided these courses are being
offered.
c) Should not register for more than five courses.
d) Parents/guardian will be called to the campus for a
meeting with the HoD for sharing the unsatisfactory
Undergraduate Academic Rules and Regulations 2026 13

academic performance of the student.
e) Students on 2nd academic warning must NOT register
for a new course, unless recommended by the HoD
and approved by Controller of Examinations.
